question.text: When recovery is received from a segregated portfolio's impaired asset, the proceeds are:

answer.text: Donated to the Investor Protection Fund
Distributed immediately to investors in proportion to their holding in the segregated portfolio
Added to the main portfolio's NAV for the benefit of current unitholders
Retained by the AMC as performance compensation

explanation.text: The Logic: Recovered money from a segregated portfolio is immediately distributed to investors in proportion to their holding in the segregated portfolio. The RTA is responsible for carrying out this distribution to the investors who hold units of the segregated portfolio. The Trap: The recovery does not go to the main portfolio's NAV, is not donated to an Investor Protection Fund, and is not retained by the AMC. The link is to the holding in the segregated portfolio itself, not to balances in the main scheme. Note: Segregated portfolio units may also be transferred or listed; the recovery distribution follows the proportional holding in the segregated portfolio at the time of distribution.
